  struct Widths
    field i8: Int8
    field i16: Int16
    field i32: Int
    field i64: Long
    field u8: UInt8
    field u16: UInt16
    field u32: UInt
    field u64: ULong
  enum WidthValue
    I8(Int8)
    I16(Int16)
    I32(Int)
    I64(Long)
    U8(UInt8)
    U16(UInt16)
    U32(UInt)
    U64(ULong)
  fun keep<T>(value: T): T
    =
      Var value
  fun render<T : ToString>(value: T): String
    =
      MethodCall toString
        Var value
  fun equalValuesHaveEqualHashes<T : Hash>(left: T, right: T): Boolean
    =
      Binary Eq
        MethodCall hash
          Var left
        MethodCall hash
          Var right
  fun renderWidth(value: WidthValue): String
    =
      WhenExpression
        Var value
        arm I8(number)
          MethodCall toString
            Var number
        arm I16(number)
          MethodCall toString
            Var number
        arm I32(number)
          MethodCall toString
            Var number
        arm I64(number)
          MethodCall toString
            Var number
        arm U8(number)
          MethodCall toString
            Var number
        arm U16(number)
          MethodCall toString
            Var number
        arm U32(number)
          MethodCall toString
            Var number
        arm U64(number)
          MethodCall toString
            Var number
